fix.description: Root cause: background allTypeHistories refetch was calling seedFromLatest which reset measurement to 0, overwriting user's in-progress edits. Fix (2fc0691b/c90fabe3 src/pages/Measurements.tsx): added userEdited ref — set to true on any +/- tap, guards the re-seed useEffect so refetches never override user edits. Screenshot shows 0.75 after 3 consecutive + taps (value retained, not reset).

judge.note: Screenshot shows 0.75 after 3 taps from 0 — value was retained across taps, not reset. userEdited ref fix is in code. Owner's measurement toggle basic add button mannequin feature also visible.

previousFix.description: Measurements stepper reset to 0 on background refetch (allTypeHistories dep triggered seedFromLatest on every React Query background refresh). Fixed (commit 2fc0691b): added userEdited useRef; set true on +/- tap, reset on type/part change; re-seed useEffect bails early if userEdited.current.

judge.note: Screenshot shows Body Measurements page with + button visible and stepper at 0.00 (initial state). Fix adds userEdited ref (Measurements.tsx) that guards re-seed on background refetch — once user taps + or -, the ref blocks subsequent allTypeHistories-triggered seedFromLatest calls. Reset on type/part change. Code fix is targeted and correct.

judge.note: Stepper confirmed working: 0 -> 0.5 -> 1.0 -> 1.5cm with no reset. Both the refetch-reset and rounding fixes are in place.
